import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["late"] = ok["actual_min"] > ok["promised_min"]
train, test = train_test_split(ok, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)

def gini(s):
    p = s.mean()
    return 1 - p**2 - (1 - p)**2

v=np.sort(train.distance_km.unique())
thresholds=(v[:-1]+v[1:])/2
def score(t):
    mask=train.distance_km<=t
    return mask.mean()*gini(train.late[mask])+(~mask).mean()*gini(train.late[~mask])
t=min(thresholds,key=score)
best_t,best_g=round(t,3),round(score(t),3)
m=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=1,random_state=0).fit(train[["distance_km"]],train.late)
tree_t=round(m.tree_.threshold[0],3)
